STB_CommonDialogue.WarpJumpSuccess: Warp Jump Successful. Incoming Message from Central Command.
STB_CommonDialogue.Tutorial1: Now that you’ve arrived successfully, let me formally welcome you to the Main Sequence Initiative.
STB_CommonDialogue.Tutorial2: As humanity’s vanguard, it is your task to build up the infrastructure required to begin colonizing this system.
STB_CommonDialogue.Tutorial3: Long-range scans have detected hostile Relic forces present in this system. Eliminating the threat these pose to future colonization efforts will be key to succeeding at your mission.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsAutomation1: Establishing mining operations here is a good start, but not all the resources you require are abundant in this area.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsAutomation2: In order to perfectly automate your production, you'll need to build mining outposts near other key resources.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsFuelEnrichment1: Deuterium Fuel is a key component of crafting Warp Fuel, which you'll need to continue to expand your production.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsFuelEnrichment2: Enrichment will continue to be an important part of your production capability, so you should plan to automate the production of Containment Coils to meet this demand.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsComputationScience: Congratulations on researching a new type of science. Producing Computation Science allows you to research many new technologies that will help improve the efficiency of your factories and ships.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsSlipstreamDrive: Now that you've unlocked the Warp Drive, you are able to travel freely between different sectors in this star system.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsSlipstreamDrive2: New areas will have new resources for your factories, but also more challenges to overcome. Use the solar system map to assess the most suitable location to expand to.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsSlipstreamDrive3: Finding a sector with both Cobalt and Graphite will make it easy to produce the next type of research, Electromagnetic Science.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsElectroSci: Now that you've established a strong base of operations in the system, you should start to prepare to deal with the threat that the Relic Destroyer poses.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsElectroSci2c: Use Electromagnetic Science to unlock new weapons and upgrade your ship in order to match the firepower of the Relic Destroyer.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsElectorSci3: For an even greater chance of success, research Quantum Science to upgrade your ship even further before taking on the Relic Destroyer.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsElectroSci4: Remember, humanity places its faith in your hands.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsRelicDestroyer: Congratulations on your victory. Humanity can rest easier now that there is one less major threat in this star cluster.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsRelicDestroyer2: However, even with the Relic Destroyer gone the threat from the Autonomous Relic Defence System is not over. Its ability to continuously replicate and expand means that humanity will always have to be on guard against future incursions.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsRelicDestroyer3: In the meantime, your task remains the same. Continue to bolster the strength of the frontier through your construction efforts, and continue to serve as humanity's shield against the unknown.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsQuantumSci: Now that you've unlocked Quantum Science, it is time to turn your attention to new star systems.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsQuantumSci2: In order to do so, you will need to unlock the Interstellar Warp Drive. It requires several new advanced components, but given the scale of the industrial operations you've already establish, I think you are up for the task.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsInterstellarWarpDrive: Congratulations on getting this far. You've distinguished yourself as an industrial mastermind and tactical fleet commander.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsInterstellarWarpDrive2: As you venture out into new star systems, continue to apply yourself to the betterment of humanity: helping those who need it and fortifying the frontier through your construction efforts.
STB_CommonDialogue.Tutorial4: Before you can do that though, you'll need to set up a base of operations.
STB_CommonDialogue.Tutorial5: Your basic training should have covered everything, but if you need a reminder you can view your objectives on the top left of your HUD, or by pressing "G". Good luck.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut2: The Designer lets you build and modify ships and stations. These designs can be saved and loaded in-game, or shared with friends.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTutSkip: Press here to replay this tutorial at any time.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut3: Here you can view the available modules for building. Hover over them to view details such as item building cost and mass.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut4: Here you can view the total modification cost.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut5: Here you can view the stats of your current design.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut6: Here you can save or load designs.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut7: When you are done modifying your ship or station, press here to confirm your changes when in-game.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut6p2: Saved designs are shared across playthroughs, and editable in the Designer on the Main Menu.
STB_CommonDialogue.DesignerTut7p2: If there are any problems with the design they will be shown here as well.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsAutomation2v2: In order to automate the next type of research, you'll have to find a large silica asteroid and set up a mining outpost nearby.
STB_CommonDialogue.NextStepsComputationScience2: Your next goal should be to unlock the Warp Drive, which will enable you to quickly travel to new sectors to find the Cobalt and Graphite you will need to automate Electromagnetic Science.
STB_CommonDialogue.AbandonedStations1: This looks like an abandoned station left by a previous colonization effort.
STB_CommonDialogue.AbandonedStations2: You should try to find the central computer core and see if there is any useful data there.
STB_CommonDialogue.AbandonedStations3: It looks like they discovered an alternative method of producing key components based on their experience surviving out here.
STB_CommonDialogue.AbandonedStations4: You should explore incorporating this into your current production lines for increased efficiency.
STB_CommonDialogue.AbandonedStations5: There are probably other abandoned stations in this star system with useful data that you should explore if possible.

STB_Descriptions.BackpackDesc: Personal equipment allowing you to carry more items.

STB_Descriptions.XenoeukaryaDesc: A complex alien species capable of advanced metabolism.
STB_Descriptions.EnzymeDesc: A catalyst in alien biosynthesis reactions.
STB_Descriptions.BetaProteinDesc: An alien compound with structural properties.

STB_Descriptions.BiolatticeDesc: An organic material used in biocomposite construction.

STB_Descriptions.MaglevCouplingDesc: A frictionless mechanical driver for high speed components.
STB_Descriptions.ExosuitDesc: The pinnacle of personal equipment, enhancing both storage and mobility.
STB_Descriptions.SolarPanelsDesc: An array of solar panels that generate a constant supply of power.
STB_Descriptions.ChromaticAlloyDesc: An extremely durable alloy used in advanced construction.
STB_Descriptions.MultisensorDesc: A complex sensor capable of measuring a wide range of phenomena.
STB_Descriptions.ArgonGasDesc: An inert gas used to shield sensitive manufacturing processes.
STB_Descriptions.RelicSynthesizerDesc: A reconstructed relic core capable of transforming and synthesizing matter.
STB_Descriptions.ProtomatterDesc: Undifferentiated matter that can be transformed into different elements.

STB_Descriptions.EnrichedFuelDesc: A more processed and efficient fuel source.
STB_Descriptions.RelicPulseCannonDesc: A heavy cannon reverse-engineered from alien technology.
STB_Descriptions.PlasmaTurretDesc: A basic weapon that rotates and automatically locks on to targets.
STB_Descriptions.PointDefenceLaserDesc: A short range beam weapon designed to track and neutralize fast moving targets.

STB_Descriptions.ArenaDesc: Test your ship designs and piloting skills against endless waves of enemies.

STB_Descriptions.ElectricalRepairKitDesc: Used to repair major electrical damage.
STB_Descriptions.WorkstationDesc: Provides a refinery and assemble to use for crafting. Cannot be automated.
STB_Descriptions.HangarDesc: Allows small shuttles and fighters to dock.
STB_Descriptions.CommendationDescription: Earn commendations by completing missions and use them to unlock bonuses and perks.
STB_Descriptions.ExperienceDescription: Gain experience and raise your rank by completing missions.
STB_Descriptions.ScannerModuleDesc: Can be used to gather information about distant regions of space, and reveal hidden points of interest.

STB_Descriptions.GrowthChamberDesc: A climate-controlled tank for cultivating microorganisms.

STB_Descriptions.TractorBeamDesc: A tractor beam capable of pulling in small floating items.
